scope: Additive current-source revalidation of the already executable Electro Dragon L1-L9 direct-parent and bounded chain baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3. Its current L1-L9 table matches the immutable active catalogue values exactly.

sources.title: Electro Dragon
sources.limitations: Confirms the direct-parent L1-L9 HP/DPS table, 30 housing space, 2.5-tile range, 3.5-second cadence, and Ground & Air targeting. It says that lightning chains to nearby buildings but does not publish jump metric, selection order, flight, target-loss, collision, intra-tick ordering, or death-lightning timing.

sources.title: Meet The Electro Dragon!
sources.limitations: Establishes a maximum of five different Ground or Air targets with decreasing damage. It describes a final death lightning release but gives no reproducible strike count, random seed, radius, damage, schedule, or deterministic ordering.

sources.title: Spring Update Full Release Notes
sources.limitations: Confirms that one Electro Dragon lightning chain cannot select the same target twice. It does not specify the selection metric or timing.

implemented_chain.damage_decay: decreasing; existing 0.8 multiplier remains secondary evidence

changed_values.previous_state: The executable direct-parent and chain baseline had a dated chain contract but no 2026-09-19 current-build confirmation in the active reference tail.
changed_values.replacement: The existing L1-L9 direct-parent values and bounded chain behavior are revalidated against a current build-pinned secondary source and current consultations of the two primary chain sources; no combat value or Core rule changes.
changed_values.justification: The new table matches every materialized direct-parent value. Public sources still do not license a more detailed chain geometry, projectile, or death-lightning model.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines a version-pinned inter-target distance metric, exact entity-emprise geometry, victim-selection order, projectile flight, collision, target-loss behavior, or same-tick ordering. The existing one-empty-tile secondary interpretation remains partial.

The official launch text confirms a final death lightning release but not a deterministic strike count, seed, radius, damage, target set, timing, or ordering. Death lightning remains absent rather than approximated.
The current build-pinned page supplies parent numeric values but no documented asset tier, animation timing, or evidence that Core's logical chain traces match client visuals.
conclusion: Electro Dragon L1-L9 remains executable through the shared Core path used by Headless, Viewer and RL, with focused chain, snapshot, replay, determinism and CLI coverage. The current direct-parent table is confirmed; detailed chain geometry and death lightning remain explicitly partial.
